Looking at the failing test `testNullRecordSeparatorCsv106`, it creates a `CSVFormat` with a specific format, header, and skips the header record. It then formats "A" and "B" values and checks if the formatted string does not end with "null".

The current bug report describes that when calling `CSVFormat.newFormat(';').withSkipHeaderRecord(true).withHeader("H1","H2").format("A","B")`, the output includes an unexpected "null" at the end (`A;Bnull`). The expected output should be `A;B`.

To summarize, the issue seems to be related to how the `CSVFormat.format` method appends values, leading to an additional "null" at the end of the formatted string.

Next, I will inspect the `CSVFormat.format` method to identify the root cause of this unexpected behavior.
